name: Summit AZ - Blog Grease in Drain 2026-10-13
body:
> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-10-13

# Summary
A seasonal Thanksgiving post: "Grease in Drain? What to Do Before It Ruins Thanksgiving" (about 1,650 words). The draft file says nothing was in WordPress yet on Oct 13; the change log records that Kim approved it and it was published the same day as post 11570 at `/blog/grease-in-drain/` (category Drains & Sewers) with BlogPosting and FAQPage (5 questions) schema.

# Keywords (Search Atlas project 5116872)
- Focus: "grease in drain" 390 / KD 22.
- Supporting: "can you put grease down the drain" 480 / KD 39 (own H2), "how to get rid of grease in drain" 90 / KD 41 (own H2).
- Cannibalization check: no page used the phrase and GSC showed 0 "grease" impressions in 3 months.
- Title (62): "Grease in Drain: How to Clear It Safely | Summit Plumbing Pros". Meta 151 characters.

# Content and sources
- People Also Ask questions answered in the FAQ (how to dissolve grease, does Drano work, what happens, how long buildup takes).
- Sources checked in a browser: City of Mesa, City of Tempe and City of Chandler fats, oils and grease pages. A 2016 Mesa news story was deliberately not used (outdated).
- Summit facts limited to the verified profile: Mesa-based, East Valley, Mon to Sat 8 to 5, free estimates, camera inspection. No prices, 24/7, warranties or reviews.

# Decisions and status
- Internal links added from posts 10592 and 10118; an FAQ answer in post 10118 was reworded so it no longer recommends flushing with hot water (it conflicted with the city guidance).
- Publish target was early November, ahead of Thanksgiving (Nov 26, 2026).
